convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to call 'CenterOfGravity' indicator (unknown custom indicator) and includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management. The custom indicator buffers and signal logic require manual Python reimplementation.

derived_values.name: SigValue buffer 0 (signal line / fast COG)
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(handle, 1, SignalBar, 2, SigValue) - buffer index 1 of CenterOfGravity indicator, reading 2 values starting at SignalBar

other_exits: Long position closed when sell signal detected (SigValue[1]==2) and BuyPosClose input is true
Short position closed when buy signal detected (SigValue[1]==1) and SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values treated as fixed lot size (0.1), positive values as deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: CenterOfGravity is a custom indicator with 2 buffers. Buffer index 1 is used for signals. The indicator returns discrete signal values: 1=uptrend, 2=downtrend. Entry requires a transition (1→2 for buy, 2→1 for sell) read from 2 consecutive bars starting at SignalBar offset. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, and LoadHistory functions. SignalBar=0 forces every-tick evaluation instead of new-bar-only. The Applied_price_ enum includes custom price types (SIMPL, QUARTER, TRENDFOLLOW0, TRENDFOLLOW1) beyond standard MT5 applied prices, which also need reimplementation.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement CenterOfGravity indicator in Python. The COG formula is: COG = -Sum(i*Price[i], i=1..N) / Sum(Price[i], i=1..N), then smoothed by SMA/EMA/etc for signal line. Buffer 1 appears to return discrete signal codes (1=buy zone, 2=sell zone) based on COG vs signal line crossover. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (position open/close with SL/TP, new bar detection, lot sizing) must be reimplemented or replaced with standard backtrader/vectorbt equivalents. The custom applied price types (SIMPL, QUARTER, TRENDFOLLOW0, TRENDFOLLOW1) also need Python implementation if used.
